summary: Grupo Televisa filed a Form 6-K responding to unusual CPO trading, attributing it to S&P DJI's preliminary index rebalancing that may remove the company from the S&P/BMV IPC effective September 21, 2026. It denies any change in results, repurchase transactions, or board member trades. No transaction or corporate action is announced; the filing merely clarifies market activity. As a routine regulatory response with no deal terms, this does not constitute a special situation, so the appropriate classification is None.
